rules.title: Owner move-in eviction relocation assistance (2026 adjustment)
rules.requirement: Owners must pay tenants relocation assistance when they evict for owner move-in. From January 1, 2026 the standard payment is $19,413, and qualifying households receive an additional $6,471.
rules.key_value: Standard payment $19,413; additional payment for qualifying households $6,471 (1.5% inflationary adjustment)
rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted for owner move-in under the Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance; the additional payment applies to qualifying households.
rules.citation: Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: The Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance requires owners to pay tenants relocation assistance in the event of an owner move-in eviction.
rules.effective_date_phrase: relocation assistance payment increases that will go into effect on January 1, 2026

rules.title: Ellis Act eviction relocation assistance (2026 adjustment)
rules.requirement: Owners must pay the same relocation assistance to tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market. From January 1, 2026 the standard payment is $19,413, and qualifying households receive an additional $6,471.
rules.key_value: Standard payment $19,413; additional payment for qualifying households $6,471 (1.5% inflationary adjustment)
rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market under the Ellis Implementation Ordinance; the additional payment applies to qualifying households.
rules.quoted_span: The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation assistance payments for tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market.
rules.effective_date_phrase: relocation assistance payment increases that will go into effect on January 1, 2026
